title: THE PIXEL COVER WRECKS
why: Job 86e ship 3: with the pixel look on, the cover wrecks (cars, skips, barriers, pipes, pallets) are one cached scene sprite each through pixWrap, keyed by kind, side, size, colour and rust. The soft contact shadow stays on the world.
now: With the pixel look on, wrecked cars, skips, barriers, pipe bundles and pallets draw as crisp pixel sprites. With the look off nothing changes.
